title: Publish and Consume a Payload
prompt: Implement the canonical acquire/release handshake: `storePayload` writes the ordinary variable **then** publishes with release; `waitAndRead` spins with acquire then reads. The graded check interleaves the calls across simulated threads and requires the payload to arrive intact.

tests.name: payload is fully published
tests.hint: storePayload: payload = value; flag.store(true, std::memory_order_release);  waitAndRead: while (!flag.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {} return payload;

tests.name: spin exits on the flag
tests.hint: The acquire loop exits as soon as the release store is observed — ordering carries the payload write.
